objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled artifact subject to version management, release processes, and lifecycle management that can be policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A company-wide regulation and process at strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Regulations and instructions that document locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process

objs.name: procedureinstruction
objs.description: Specific procedures within a framework that describe process sequences, details and responsible persons

objs.name: workinstruction
objs.description: Detailed documentation of special work steps and sub-processes with forms and checklists

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document, subject to its own versioning and affecting the main document version

objs.name: additionalinfo
objs.description: A document supplement not subject to the release cycle of the main document and not requiring formal approval

objs.name: changeproposal
objs.description: A planned amendment to an existing document managed without affecting content or version history

objs.name: validityextensionrequest
objs.description: A system-generated request to check document validity after a defined period before expiration

objs.name: overriderequest
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity

objs.name: reactivationrequest
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with the system in various roles

objs.name: author
objs.description: A person responsible for creating and editing document content

objs.name: coauthor
objs.description: A person with personal change rights in addition to the primary author

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A person who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A person responsible for deciding whether a document is released and distributed to readers

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A person responsible for translating released document content into other languages

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A person who can only view approved objects and documents

objs.name: usergroup
objs.description: A collection of users assigned together for authorization and distribution purposes

objs.name: authorizationgroup
objs.description: A defined group in the system for assigning read and change rights to documents

objs.name: distributionlist
objs.description: A list of User Groups and persons assigned to receive document distribution

objs.name: organizationalunit
objs.description: A structural entity that documents can be linked to

objs.name: risk
objs.description: An entity that documents can be linked to

objs.name: masterdata
objs.description: Reference data that documents can be automatically linked to

objs.name: itapplication
objs.description: A software application that documents can be linked to

objs.name: client
objs.description: A system entity for which document visibility can be specified in a multi-client system

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of document type

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Edit document content and metadata properties after creation

evts.name: upload_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to a document object

evts.name: convert_document
evts.description: Automatically convert document to PDF format after saving

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group and person-related authorizations to a document for readers and role holders

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled document attachment to a document that is automatically released with the main document

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add a document supplement that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a planned amendment to a document without affecting content or version history

evts.name: submit_document
evts.description: Initiate the approval process for a document by starting the workflow

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Complete a workflow task with electronic signature by document participants

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content according to technical and formal aspects during the review workflow step

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and distribute a document to readers in the release workflow step

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release making it visible to addressed readers

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new version of a released document with retained data that can be adapted

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving when it is no longer relevant to a new document version

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Review and approve translated document content during translation workflow

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve translated document making it visible to authorized readers in corresponding login language

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated request created when a document reaches 30 days before validity expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Approve and extend document validity by updating the Valid until date

evts.name: revise_due_to_validity_check
evts.description: Create a new version of a document when revision is needed during validity extension check

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document invalid and archive it revoking all authorizations except archive group

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate an invalidated document creating a new version with retained metadata and properties

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Send email notification to assigned users and user groups when a new document version is released

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request users to actively confirm acknowledgement of a document release via email

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow-supported acknowledgement of document receipt and review by assigned users

evts.name: assign_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign user groups and persons to a distribution list for document distribution and dashboard access

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible in a multi-client system

evts.name: print_metadata
evts.description: Automatically print document metadata in document content using TAG technology
